payload.friendly_name: Nightly Suites Green — coord & charter rework fallout
payload.purpose_context: After large internal reworks (the next coordination seam and the doctrine-to-charter cutover), the nightly escalated five P0 issues totalling 28 failing tests. This mission restores a green nightly by fixing one genuine ownership-boundary regression and realigning the remaining test/CI/doc/perf drift, preserving the red-CI-means-no-release discipline.
payload.purpose_tldr: Return the nightly test suites to green after the coordination and charter reworks so the 4.0.0 release gate stays honest.

reason: Independent review (opus/reviewer-renata) PASS. Red-first proof CONFIRMED: both targeted tests fail on un-hardened oracle (m-coord still listed as fallback; remote-tracking arm (F,T,T)) and pass on hardened. F6 independence holds: oracle re-derives remote presence via its own batched git ls-remote --heads (LiveRemoteHeads), never the resolver; monkeypatching surface_resolver._coord_branch_exists_via_remote->False makes resolver diverge while oracle still says present; fail-closed-to-present (inconclusive) matches #2614 guard. C-002 pin changes are CORRECTED semantics not weakening: third tuple element reinterpreted to 'present on a remote (tracking ref OR live hit)'; remote-tracking/remote-only now (F,F,T) because a remote-present branch is NOT a deleted-coordination fallback (matching resolver); old remote-only (F,T,F) encoded the #5990 blind spot. Symmetric difference_problems preserves real divergence detection both directions; demoted line was the oracle's own over-listing, now correctly subtracted. lane-d corpus reds are a PRE-EXISTING worktree-env artifact: base fails identically in lane-d (532/29 same missions), main checkout green with WP04 content (2 passed). mypy no-any-return pre-existing (base line 298). ruff clean.
